I’ve been using rain rain for years to play audio while I’m asleep, and also to listen to background noise of some kind that isn’t just a podcast (which can often be distracting and disorienting) when I’m doing homework or focusing and need to buckle down and get stuff done. The ability to use up to three different audio tracks at once is so good and means you can create your own preferred sound/atmosphere. Also, you can mix them too, so if you think a sound is nice but too loud or too grating, you can individually change their volume and make them “softer” or make them oscillate in a 4D audio effect. Also, Rain Rain audio will still play in the background when you listen to Spotify, YouTube, videos in your web browser, or music on YouTube Music, so you can also hear your sounds while you do something else really quick, then pause your other media and resume focusing without having to shut off Rain Rain sounds before you switch to a different audio/video media. The ads never interrupt the audio or block the screen, they’re simple lower screen banner ads that are passively there. Also, I adore the daily premium sounds feature so I can try out some of the premium sounds to mix things up every day when I need to focus while working on homework. Also, I’ve used this app for genuinely so long and I’m so happy it hasn’t changed to make ads more obtrusive, there are still tons of free sounds, and I’m still surprised that they didn’t try to make using multiple audios or mixing controls a premium feature. Premium is literally only to unlock more sounds, and I’m perfectly fine with the free sounds and saved mixes I’ve made. Genuinely the best app I have on my phone right now, the UI is perfect, the features aren’t blocked by $$$, and the ads won’t blast thru your speaker when you’re trying to sleep or study.
